title: LmoltenShow-OffRedOnionsAgave-Poke
description: A low-glycemic-friendly, molten and jammy dish featuring red onions in a tender Agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Wash Agave leaves and place them in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Slice red onions thinly, removing the root ends.
Drizzle Agave nectar over sliced onions, sprinkle with salt and cumin seeds.
Cover with clean, folded kitchen towel, letting marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 200°C (392°F). Place onion slices on top of Agave leaves in the center of each leaf.
Cook for 18-20 minutes or until caramelized onions are bubbly and golden brown, and Agave leaves have softened.
Carefully transfer cooked Agave leaf vessels onto serving plates using oven mitts.
Serve hot as a low-glycemic-friendly dessert alternative to traditional poke.
